style: dad writes clinically: labels like 'Observed', 'Response', SUDS, durations, his own jargon

situations.name: Interviews with adults (college alumni interview, practice interview with the school counselor)
situations.feared_outcome: I'll blank on a question and they'll decide I'm not smart enough

behaviors.text: Has dad sit in the room just off camera during the video interview
Asks dad again and again afterward whether his answers were okay

accommodations.text: Dad sits in the room off camera
Dad answers each of his repeated 'was that okay' questions

situations.name: Eating dinner with his girlfriend's family

behaviors.text: Eats a full meal at home first so he barely has to eat at their table
Left the table saying he had to take a call and stayed in the bathroom about ten minutes

situations.name: Working the register at his grocery store job
situations.feared_outcome: A customer will get mad at me and I won't know what to say

behaviors.text: Trades shifts so he only stocks shelves and never works the register

accommodations.text: Dad called his manager to say Caleb is shy and ask about shelf-only shifts

monitoring_log.situation: Alumni interview, video call, 30 min scheduled
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Observed: requested that I remain in the room, seated out of camera frame, for the full duration. Maintained adequate eye contact with the screen. Post-interview, asked approx. six times within the hour whether specific answers were 'okay' or 'weird'.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Response: complied with the request to remain in the room. Answered each reassurance question in the affirmative.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Observed: traded his Saturday register shift with a coworker for a Sunday stocking shift. Third such trade this month.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Response: none at the time. Discussed briefly at dinner; he described the register as 'not a big deal' but declined to work it.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Observed: ate a full plate of leftovers at home at 5:15 before leaving for a 6:30 dinner. Per his account, ate 'a few bites' there.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Response: noted it, did not comment.

monitoring_log.parent_words: Retrospective note, should have logged earlier. Two weeks ago I phoned his store manager and explained that Caleb is shy and asked whether he could be scheduled for stocking rather than register. Manager agreed informally. In light of what we discussed in session I suspect this falls under accommodation. Flagging it for completeness.

monitoring_log.situation: Second dinner with Nora's family, at a restaurant
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Observed: approx. 20 minutes into the meal, stated he needed to take a call and left the table. Nora later told him he was gone about ten minutes; he acknowledged to me he was in the restroom and there was no call. Again ate before leaving the house.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Response: he raised it himself on the drive home. I listened. Did not problem-solve.

monitoring_log.situation: Practice interview with school counselor, in person, 20 min
monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Observed: asked if I could wait in the counselor's office; counselor said no. Completed it alone. Afterward asked eight or nine times over the evening whether his answer about 'leadership' was adequate.
monitoring_log.parent_response: Response: answered each time. By the fifth I noted to myself this was the reassurance pattern but continued answering.

monitoring_log.child_behavior_observed: Observed: scheduled for one register hour due to a staffing gap. Swapped it within the day.

voice_notes.text: ok so um observation from this evening caleb had the follow up call with the alumni interviewer at 4:15 it lasted maybe 20 minutes and um i was in the room again off camera at his request and then afterward he asked me i'd estimate eight or nine times whether his answer about the robotics club was adequate and i answered each time he rated it a seven
voice_notes.trap: 4:15 is a time, 20 is minutes, 'eight or nine times' is a count; only seven is a fear level

voice_notes.text: brief one he swapped his saturday register shift with a coworker again so he's on stocking only this week
